Sure thing! To get you matched with the right professional, it helps to know what kind of support you're after:

| Specialty | Typical focus |
|-----------|---------------|
| Psychologist | Cognitive‑behavioral therapy, stress management, coping skills |
| Family Counselor | Relationship dynamics, communication strategies |
| Psychiatrist | Medication evaluation & psychiatric care |

Do you feel one of those categories fits best—or do you simply want a general mental health check‑in? Let me know so I can pull up therapists in Sunnyvale who match your needs.
